# function: parse_size

Converts a spec-encoding size name (e.g. nvme-2c-8gb) into CPU cores, RAM (MB), package ID, pricing ID, and daily price.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
parse_size(size string) object
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `size` (String) The size name (e.g. nvme-2c-8gb, ssd-4c-16gb, dev-8c-32gb)
